The YS, UTS and ductility of the homogenized and annealed condition, SA750 were found to be ~796 MPa, ~989 MPa and 17% respectively.

The TEM and APT results indicate that in 60CRA condition, globular precipitates are on the order of ~105 nm while the length and width of lamellar/cellular precipitates are on the order of ~380 nm and ~60 nm respectively.
